featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Dr. Vineeta and I recently visited Looks Salon with the hope of restoring my hair health and getting some fresh highlights — and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. As a doctor, I value professionalism, knowledge, and genuine care, and the team at Looks Salon exceeded my expectations in every way.
Right from the start, I was greeted warmly by Pradosh, one of the managers. His welcoming smile and thoughtful guidance immediately made me feel comfortable. He listened to my concerns carefully and assigned me to the perfect person for my needs — Zaara Kazi.
Zaara was exceptional. She is incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to thoroughly understand my hair and scalp condition. Not only did she perform the service beautifully, but she also patiently educated me on how to maintain my hair health at home. She recommended products tailored specifically to my scalp type and shared small but meaningful daily tips that truly made a difference. Thanks to her, I’ve fallen in love with my hair again — something I didn’t think would happen after losing hope in how my hair looked. She's genuinely my Hair Fairy Godmother and truly an Angel..! ✨
I also want to appreciate Ashish, who assisted Zaara throughout the process. He handled my sensitive scalp so gently and professionally, making the entire experience very comfortable for me.
Additionally, I had my eyebrows done by Siddika, and I was blown away by her skill. For the first time ever, I experienced almost no pain while getting my eyebrows shaped. She understood exactly what I wanted and gave me the perfect shape — something I’ve been searching for after many disappointing experiences elsewhere. She’s incredibly talented, and I’m so relieved to finally find someone I can trust with my brows.
Overall, this visit was truly rejuvenating and transformative. I left the salon not just looking better, but feeling more confident and cared for. I will definitely be recommending Looks Salon to my friends and family — especially the wonderful team members who made my experience outstanding: Pradosh, Zaara Kazi, Ashish, and Siddika.
Thank you for helping me feel like myself again! 💛
